l.i: Fingere, vel mortem tragicam, vel dogmata tetra,
Nulli visa prius, nulli exaudita piorum,
Ingenti clamore tona, qui cornua vincat,
Clangoremque tuba. Sic fortis habeberis, idem
Inuictus fidei patronus, & alter Achilles,
Impiger, iracundus, inexorabilis, acer,
Stans in fuggesto, mundi in delicta ruentis
Fraudes, & scelera, & Sodoma superantia longe
Flagitia, & turpes flammas, homicidia, furta,
Vfuras, artefque malas, vel carpe modeste, (do.
Vel (mage quod gratu est) prorsus preme dissimula-
In Caluinistas contra tua fulmina mitte,
Quarto quoque notans verbo: sic ibis ad astra,
Sic Proceres, magnique Duces, ad dicta stupescent,
Grata gynaceo si dices, cui tua lingua
Venalis, Domina nutus edocta vereri,
Quae simul audierit quam sis immitis & atrox
In Caluinistas importuno ore tribunus,
Implebit v acuam tibi latabunda crumenam,
Donatura suburbani quoque prædia ruris,
Vel pulchras emptura ædes, si viderit acrem
Infectatorem Zuinglii Bezaque futurum.
Nec tamen errorem monstra, sed sedulus vsque
Hoc age, ne vulgus possit cognoscere, quanam
Caluini fuerit doctrina. Hinc prouidus ergo
Principis edicto cura exturbanda tabernis
Caluinistarum scripta impia, plena veneni
Haec tibi sint, quamvis Ecclesia rauca reclamet.
Atque

page.notes: The scan shows a stray right-hand edge of the following page ("Atqne" catchword and dark marks at far right); the catchword "Atque" is read from the scan as "Atqne" and is doubtful. The word "Vfuras" and "Caluinistas" are as printed. The printed "(do." beside the verse line is a marginal note fragment, not text of the verse; it is transcribed in the main text as printed to avoid loss. Some letters in the italic verse ("gynaceo", "vsque") are doubtful. Possible misreading of "fuggesto" (fuggesto/suggesto). The paragraph and line breaks are uncertain because the verse is set as one unbroken block; the division into a single stanza is an approximation.
